name: zmodel_fog_apply_current_color
description: zModel applies the current fog color by tail-calling zRndr::FogColor_SetRgb01Clamped with the model fog color global.
known_limits: Tier C only; no reviewed VC COFF byte comparison has been accepted, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4762f0 validates loading ECX with &gModel_FogColorRgb01 and tail-jumping to zRndr::FogColor_SetRgb01Clamped.

Binary Ninja assembly for dependency 0x49b1e0 validates in-place RGB clamping to 0..1, cached zRndr fog color update when the color differs outside tolerance, and hardware pending color update through zVideo::SetFogColorFromRgb01 when g_zVideo_ActiveRendererPath is nonzero.

Native smoke zmodel_fog_apply_current_color_smoke verifies the model fog color global is clamped in place, zRndr::g_fogColorParams receives the clamped color, and the active renderer path updates zVideo pending 255-scale fog color.
